review_question: Does the learner have a clear starting point?
Does the learner have one or two realistic target directions?
Does the learner have a skills inventory?
Does the learner have visible proof of at least one skill?
Is the portfolio understandable to an external reader?
Does the CV or profile match the target direction?
Can the learner explain their work clearly?
Has the learner received feedback from at least one person?
Does the learner have a short-term action plan?
Does the learner have a resilience or backup plan?
